learning_objective.text_en: Know the sin, cos & tan values of 0, 30, 45, 60 & 90 degrees. Use basic triangles to be able to deduce these values without a calculator.
learning_objective.text_zh: 知道0度、30度、45度、60度和90度的正弦、余弦和正切值。能够使用基本三角形推导这些值，无需计算器。
